_comment: audio.cpp models for the 'TextToSpeech' tab. Each entry is one text-to-speech model. 'folder' is resolved against audiocpp_models_dir (configs/constants.json); use 'path' instead for an absolute path. 'id' is the model id the audio.cpp server exposes; 'family' must match a file in model_specs/ (e.g. kokoro_tts, qwen3_tts, pocket_tts). Optional keys: 'mode', 'load_options', 'session_options', 'default_request_options', 'voice_presets', 'default_voice_preset'. Entries missing alias/id/family/path are ignored.
